newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone-Poulenc not interested in Sanofi.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc not interested in Sanofi.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc chairman Jean-Rene Fourtou said on Thursday his company was not interested in buying Sanofi nor in a link-up with this company.
"Firstly as far as I understand Sanofi is not for sale. But Elf has said it is willing to go below 50 percent," he told a news conference.
Sanofi is a unit of French oil group Elf Aquitaine.
"I want to make clear that we are not interested in an acquisition of Sanofi nor in a link-up with this company," he said.
He added that while there could be some advantages to such a scheme, it would not provide Rhone-Poulenc with a better access to markets in Japan and the rest of the Far East.
